rationale: The fixed implementation selects either the short-sector size or normal-sector size according to whether the directory length is below the header threshold; the vulnerable implementation always uses the normal-sector size. The Logic section only says that the valid range is calculated from the header's minimum size and directory length, without explicitly stating that either quantity controls sector-size selection or describing the short-sector branch. This wording is suggestive of the fixed-side delta but is too imprecise to unambiguously encode it. The remaining claims about comparing the end pointer against the stream start and range, and reporting an error on failure, hold for both implementations.
